description: One AI-generated video per day, featured on the Daily Video tab (video-daily.html). Generated on Venice video models; newest entry is featured. Maintained by the daily-video automation routine.

videos.title: GPU Silicon Macro
videos.prompt: Extreme macro shot gliding across a next-generation GPU die under a microscope: shimmering teal light traces pulse across dark indigo silicon substrate, cream-colored solder points glint like tiny stars as the camera sweeps over crystalline circuitry, particles of light drifting above the wafer surface, ultra shallow depth of field, cinematic product-photography lighting, photorealistic, no text, no watermarks.

videos.title: Benchmark Control Room
videos.prompt: Cinematic shot inside a futuristic AI benchmark control room: glowing teal holographic bar charts and leaderboard panels rise and shuffle in mid-air above a dark indigo console, thin cream-colored light traces flow between them like neural circuitry. Camera slowly orbits, shallow depth of field, volumetric light, ultra clean sci-fi aesthetic, no text, no watermarks.
